task: Decouple provider-level config from project/tooling config in the profile system (ConfigLoader/ProviderProfile) and add a migration so users can switch providers while preserving shared project/assistant/skills config.

component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.affected: config schema (src/env/types.ts, new WorkspaceConfig split out of ProviderProfile), ConfigLoader service (src/utils/config.ts), migration subsystem (new 006 migration + registration), two CLI workflows (profile display/index, assistants historyLoader/setup selection utils), Claude agent plugin (statusline.mjs)
component_scope.layers: config schema, service (ConfigLoader), migration, CLI (profile + assistants setup), agent plugin

requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.gaps: exact target schema shape and which fields counted as project-level vs. legitimately provider-scoped were undecided at research time; resolved during spec brainstorming

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: no exact precedent in the codebase for splitting ProviderProfile vs. WorkspaceConfig; requires a data migration rewriting existing users' persisted global and local config files, atomically resolving the codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration identity trio from a single source profile
technical_risk.mitigation: reused the established Migration/MigrationRegistry pattern (5 prior migrations existed); migration 006 unit-tested per the config.migration.test.ts pattern; a post-implementation bug in the source-profile selection (dropping the identity trio when the active profile only had an unrelated field set) was found via manual testing and fixed with a dedicated regression test

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 6 distinct areas across 4+ subsystems: config schema (src/env/types.ts — new WorkspaceConfig abstraction split out of ProviderProfile), the core ConfigLoader service (src/utils/config.ts — workspace resolution, splitProfileAndWorkspace, WORKSPACE_KEYS), the migration subsystem (new 006 migration + registration in src/migrations/index.ts), two CLI command workflows (profile display/index, assistants historyLoader/selection utils), and the Claude agent plugin's statusline.mjs, which now reads workspace.codeMieUrl directly.

No exact precedent in the codebase for splitting ProviderProfile vs. WorkspaceConfig, though the migration itself reuses the established Migration/MigrationRegistry pattern (5 prior migrations exist). Red flag applied: the change requires an actual data migration (006-decouple-provider-workspace-config.migration.ts) that rewrites existing users' persisted global and local config files, atomically resolving the codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration 'identity trio' from a single source profile — bumped Technical Risk from M to L.

14 source/test files touched (2 new: the 006 migration and its test; 12 modified) spanning src/env/, src/utils/, src/migrations/, src/cli/commands/profile/, src/cli/commands/assistants/, and src/agents/plugins/claude/plugin/ — base XL for the 11-15 file band, and the same data-migration red flag bumps it further to XXL.

4 distinct layers touched: DB-Persistence (local config file schema + migration of stored profiles/workspace), Service (ConfigLoader.resolveWorkspace / splitProfileAndWorkspace business logic), Workflow (profile and assistants-setup CLI commands), and Agent-Tool (the Claude plugin's statusline.mjs reading the new workspace.codeMieUrl shape) — with a required migration, matching the L criteria (3-4 layers including persistence, migration required).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): requires data migration (006-decouple-provider-workspace-config.migration.ts) to move existing users' identity/workspace fields out of their stored provider profiles.
File Change Estimate bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6): same data-migration red flag additionally bumps file change scope.
